info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Insurance Claims Claims Adjusters-v1-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Adjuster Retrieval API provides access to a list of insurance claims associated with specific claims adjusters. This endpoint allows users, such as claims managers and insurance personnel, to retrieve detailed information about claims handled by various adjusters. Developers can leverage this API to optimize claims processing workflows, ensure efficient claims management, and monitor adjuster performance. With straightforward queries, businesses can improve transparency and accountability within their claims operations.

get.summary: Retrieve claims assigned to a specific adjuster.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain a list of claims that are currently assigned to a particular adjuster, providing detailed information necessary for review and management.

requestBody.description: Retrieve a list of adjusters related to claims. This request body is formulated to specify the necessary parameters to filter the results accordingly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the adjuster details.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsAdjustersReques.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operations related to claims adjuster. It is expected to be a string value.
